scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @apex/os build && pnpm test
scripts.//test: No --exclude flag: the root vitest.config.ts already includes only packages/** and apps/**, so integration-tests/ cannot match. An unquoted integration-tests/** glob was expanded by POSIX shells (but not by cmd.exe), which turned the second expanded path into a positional filter and made every CI run fail while Windows passed.
scripts.//verify: typecheck FIRST: it runs tsc -b, which emits the dist/ that the workspace packages' exports point at. Then the staff app is built, because the API serves it and tests assert on the headers it is served with — without this, `pnpm verify` passes while the shipped bundle is never compiled, and those tests silently depend on a stale local build.
